subject: How to pass command line arguments from Java to R?

messages.author: 9631c6d11578bc86
messages.subject: How to pass command line arguments from Java to R?
parts:
Hi,
 We have the following code snippet in our R script. We wanted to call this script from Java with needed arguments using renjin java api. .

test.R:-
******
args <- commandArgs(TRUE)
model <- as.character(args[1]);
print(model)

Can you tell us how do we pass it?

// create a script engine manager
        ScriptEngineManager manager = new ScriptEngineManager();
         
        // create a Renjin engine:
        ScriptEngine engine = manager.getEngineByName("Renjin");
         
        // check if engine has loaded correctly:
        if (engine == null) {
            throw new RuntimeException ("Renjin Script Engine not found on the classpath.");
        }
        else {
            System.out.println ("Renjin Script Engine initialized!");
        }

 engine.eval (new java.io.FileReader ("test.R"));
...//TODO

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: How to pass command line arguments from Java to R?
parts:
I have added a section to the documentation on how to specify command line arguments for a Renjin ScriptEngine:
http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/library/execution-context.html#command-line-arguments

Note that the Scripting API provides a much richer API for passing values from Java to R if you are not constrainted to using the commandArgs() function.

Best,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: How to pass command line arguments from Java to R?
parts:
Hi,
 Thanks for the reply. Can you enhance the documentation(or reply) little bit with small test.R and how that external R file can be loaded with the code snippet you have provided and with the sample output. I have referred the code snippet and it worked as R code snippet is part of the java code. But i have the external R file to be called and passed the arguments from Java.
  I have tested the other ways like passing as variables using engine.put(key,value); We have some legacy R scripts which reads some command line arguments. So wanted to handle it in the same way.

Regards
Ravi.P

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: How to pass command line arguments from Java to R?
parts:
Hi Ravi,
You can find an example of evaluating an external script here:
http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/library/evaluating.html

For example:

try(FileReader reader = new FileReader("myscript.R")) {
  engine.eval(reader);
}

Best,
Alex
